statBlock.name: Awakened Shrub
statBlock.description: A small plant made sentient by magic. It can look like a flowering bush or a walking piece of topiary.

sections.Actions: Rake. Melee attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 1 Slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Awakened Tree
statBlock.description: A living tree that can walk and speak. Some stand motionless for long stretches, while others patrol places steeped in natural magic.

sections.Actions: Slam. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Myconid Adult
statBlock.description: An Underdark fungus folk defender that keeps intruders away from its colony.

sections.Traits: Sun Sickness. In sunlight, the myconid has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. It dies if it spends more than 1 hour in sunlight.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.
Pacifying Spores (1/day). One visible creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On failure, it is Stunned. It can end the effect by succeeding on a repeat save at the end of any of its turns. After 1 minute, the save succeeds automatically.
Rapport Spores. Release spores in a 30-ft. Emanation from the myconid. Creatures in the area with Intelligence 2 or higher gain telepathy out to 30 ft. for 1 hour. Constructs, Elementals, and Undead gain nothing from the spores.

statBlock.name: Myconid Sovereign
statBlock.description: A tall myconid whose layered growths set it apart from the adults it leads. It tends the colony and its fungal blooms.

sections.Traits: Sun Sickness. In sunlight, the myconid has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. It dies if it spends more than 1 hour in sunlight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Slam attack and use Pacifying Spores.
Slam. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (2d4 + 1) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.
Animating Spores (3/day). Release spores on a Small or Medium corpse within 5 ft. It must have belonged to a creature other than a Construct or Undead. After 24 hours, it rises as a Myconid Spore Servant. The animation lasts 1d4 + 1 weeks or ends when the servant is destroyed. These spores can animate that corpse only once.
Pacifying Spores. One visible creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On failure, it is Stunned. It can end the effect by succeeding on a repeat save at the end of any of its turns. After 1 minute, the save succeeds automatically.
Rapport Spores. Release spores in a 30-ft. Emanation from the myconid. Creatures in the area with Intelligence 2 or higher gain telepathy out to 30 ft. for 1 hour. Constructs, Elementals, and Undead gain nothing from the spores.

statBlock.name: Myconid Sprout
statBlock.description: A small myconid that tends the colony and watches for trespassers.

sections.Traits: Sun Sickness. In sunlight, the myconid has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. It dies if it spends more than 1 hour in sunlight.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 1 (1d4 - 1) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.
Rapport Spores. Release spores in a 30-ft. Emanation from the myconid. Creatures in the area with Intelligence 2 or higher gain telepathy out to 30 ft. for 1 hour. Constructs, Elementals, and Undead gain nothing from the spores.

statBlock.name: Twig Blight
statBlock.description: A tangle of moving twigs that hides near deadwood and ambushes travelers in groups.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. It has Advantage on attacks against a creature while at least one of its allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Vine Blight
statBlock.description: A humanoid silhouette wrapped in vines. It can tangle foes in sudden plant growth and may repeat the words of its victims.

sections.Actions:
Constricting Vine. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is Grappled (escape DC 12). While the grapple lasts, the target takes 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns and the blight cannot use Constricting Vine.
Entangling Plants (recharge 5–6). Cast Entangle using Constitution (spell save DC 12).

statBlock.name: Needle Blight
statBlock.description: A gaunt walking plant that lashes out with thorn-covered claws or flings volleys of needles.

sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (2d4 + 1) Slashing damage.
Needles. Ranged attack, +3 to hit, range 30/60 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (2d4 + 1) Piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Violet Fungus
statBlock.description: A slow-moving fungus whose lashing tendrils rot flesh on contact.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rotting Touch attacks.
Rotting Touch. Melee attack, +2 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.
